name: bosla-services
description: Portable TypeScript services for the Bosla app, staged for integration: the Habit Tracker's recompute-honest habit engine + AI Goals planner (ported from the Adaptive Habit League Electron app), and Masar.ai's career-discovery AI pipeline (ported from the Masar.ai notebook). No Electron, no database, no HTTP framework — plain functions and provider-agnostic AI clients that Bosla's real backend wires up.
